To: Operations and Finance Leadership
From: Supply Chain Director
Date: [Insert Date]
Subject: Network shipping plan to meet all orders at the lowest total transportation cost

Situation
We operate a network of multiple shipping origins and multiple delivery destinations. Each origin has a defined amount of inventory available for this cycle, and each destination has a firm quantity requirement. Transportation spend and on-time service are priority metrics. We need a clear, repeatable shipping plan that holds costs down while keeping shelves stocked and customers satisfied.

Problem
We must determine how much to ship from each origin to each destination, recognizing that:
- Every destination must receive its full requirement for the period.
- No origin can ship more than it has available.
- Shipping costs vary significantly by route; sending from a higher-cost origin may be necessary when nearby inventory is insufficient.
- Shipments must be in whole-unit quantities; partial loads are not allowed.

Goal
Build a practical, lane-by-lane shipment plan that meets every destination’s needs without exceeding origin inventories and achieves the lowest possible total transportation spend, while adhering to whole-unit shipping.

Approach and considerations
- Use the route-by-route cost data to direct volume to lower-cost lanes first, allocating remaining requirements to alternative lanes only when needed to cover demand.
- Validate that the proposed allocations observe available inventory at each origin and meet all destination requirements in whole units.
- Highlight any operational sensitivities (e.g., dock capacity, carrier availability, delivery windows) that could require minor adjustments without materially increasing spend.
- If total network supply is tight in certain areas, expect some reliance on longer or higher-cost lanes; we will flag these cases and propose mitigation where feasible.

Next steps
- Confirm the supply, demand, and route cost inputs in the annex.
- Generate the recommended shipment allocations and expected transportation spend for leadership review.
- Finalize the routing guide and release instructions to transportation planning and warehouse operations.
